The '''Shinbone system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> located in the [[Instrop sector/Legends|Instrop sector]]<ref name="Shinbone Showdown" /> of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shinbone]],<ref name="Twitter" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]-turned-[[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance]].<ref name="Raid on Picutorion">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=swminis/article/huntwithin1|text=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1|int=The Hunt Within: Valance's Tale: Part 1}}</ref>
